verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own API-key docs name an official 'Core JavaScript SDK' alongside the REST API and CLI, so a first-party SDK exists. That single line is the only SDK evidence: there are no SDK reference docs, no Python or other language SDKs, and nothing showing how the SDK works in practice. The REST API and CLI are separate surfaces and are not credited as SDKs. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation and reference, multi-language SDK coverage (e.g., Python), evidence of maintenance and currency, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.
